row: City Creatures Animal Hospital is a full-service small animal hospital specializing in avian and exotic care. We provide top of the line care to all small animals from dogs and cats to lizards, birds, rodents and more. If you need a vet in Buffalo, NY, please give us a call today at 716-873-7000!
